messages:
Priya: quick check — where are we on marlin7b manifest + licensing? catalog freeze is EOD and I want to confirm there are no hard blockers.
Luca: one legal nit: tokenizer wrapper had a binary blob flagged. legal wants either removal or confirmation of compatible license. @Maya any update on that?
Maya: Legal gave conditional ok if we remove the blob and add an attribution file. I'll prepare a manifest patch + LICENSE_NOTE. ETA ~2h.
Sam: perf note — staging latency looks ok (p95 ~120ms @1k), but ingest job reported embeddings shape mismatch for downstream consumers. @Priya do we want the new dense shape or keep legacy?
Priya: prefer dense-embed (better memory profile). We'll include a migration transform in ingest.
Luca: who owns the ingest change? need an owner to make the transform and CR.
Ken: I can own the ingest schema change. Quick question: target vector length is 1536, right? and we should surface as vector<float> in the manifest?
Maya: yes 1536, and add manifest field model_metadata.embedding_shape = [1536]. Also legal asked whether we plan to ship q8_0 quant — that needs a perf guardrail doc.
Sam: q8_0 was validated on dev boxes but I'll add a perf regression test in the CR. I'll also add a canary tag 'marlin7b-canary-1' for 48h so we can monitor quality.
Priya: timeline proposal: manifest + license note merged today -> ingest CR + perf tests -> canary starts tomorrow. Sound OK?
Luca: yep. product has no objections. main gating items: Maya's license patch and Ken's CR.
Ken: I'll open the ingest CR in ~30m. will include transform + unit test + perf harness. If CI needs more capacity I may ask infra.
eng-infra-bot: eng-infra: noted. We can provision a 4xA100 runner under priority 'catalog-onboard' within ~3h if you create an infra request ticket.
Maya: uploaded manifest diff: https://redwood.internal/changes/1234 (includes LICENSE_NOTE + manifest fields). PTAL.
Sam: left a small formatting comment on model_size field in the manifest. will push a tiny patch after Ken's CR lands.
Ken: CR opened: https://repo.internal/changes/567 — includes ingest migration + perf tests. @Sam @Luca assigned as reviewers.
Sam: reviewing now. will approve after CI passes. added a nightly sanity check to catch embedding shape regressions.
Luca: I'll coordinate the canary schedule once CR + manifest are merged. Marking this thread to close after merges. :thumbsup: 
Priya: thanks all. quick legal/template ask — if legal needs a citation, use a file named LEGAL_CITATION.md at the model package root and reference it from the manifest.
Maya: will do. posting final merge link when done.
Priya: great — ping here when merged and I'll update the catalog launch board.
